sn1.58:1.1: “Deviation” is _uppatha_ (“off course”). | These questions and answers are included in [sn1.76]().
sn1.58:1.4: A reference to the belief that bathing in water brings purity. Compare the “inner bathing” at [mn7:18.5]().
sn1.58:2.5: “Fervor and celibacy” (_tapas_ and _brahmacariya_) are closely linked in Atharva Veda 11.5, which eulogizes the brahmacārin as the force of potency creating even the gods.
